title: npx playwright install hangs after the first browser download on Playwright 1.55 to 1.59 with recent Node releases
symptoms: The download reaches 100% and then the install prints nothing and never exits
CI jobs time out on the install step after a Node image bump to 26.x or 24.16
The same Playwright version installs fine on node:24.15.0
cause: Playwright before 1.60 unpacked browsers with a yauzl stream whose close event never fires under newer Node stream lifecycle behavior, so the extract step waits forever. Playwright 1.60 vendors a patched yauzl.
fix: Upgrade Playwright to 1.60.0 or later. That is the only real fix, since the hang also appears on the Node 24 LTS line from 24.16.
affected: Playwright 1.55.1 to 1.59.x on recent Node releases (26.x, 24.16 and later); fixed in 1.60.0 (released 2026-05-11)
